name: Sharp Rattlesnake 74

description: Rounded white password input that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, the outline is removed, border-color becomes #818cf8, background-color changes from #f8fafc to #fff. On focus, the outline is removed, border-color becomes #818cf8, background-color changes from #f8fafc to #fff.
